post.originalText:
GPT images is crazy insane for AI UGC

JSON prompt here:

```json
{
  "prompt_type": "photorealistic_reference_reconstruction",
  "objective": "Recreate the supplied reference as a clean vertical smartphone selfie. Match face, freckles, messy dark wavy hair, black tank, bedroom clutter, soft window light, bored/neutral expression. Remove all text, UI, logos, watermarks.",
  "reference_fidelity": {
    "target": "extremely high visual similarity",
    "priority_order": [
      "facial proportions and heavy-lidded brown eyes",
      "freckles across nose and cheeks",
      "messy voluminous dark-brown wavy hair with flyaways",
      "black ribbed tank top",
      "soft natural window light from camera-left",
      "cluttered bedroom background",
      "raw phone selfie texture"
    ]
  },
  "canvas": {
    "orientation": "portrait",
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
    "framing": "close head-and-shoulders smartphone selfie",
    "crop": "top of hair to upper chest",
    "subject_alignment": "centered, slight forward lean",
    "perspective": "arm-length front camera, mild wide"
  },
  "scene": {
    "location": "lived-in bedroom",
    "time_of_day": "daytime",
    "mood": "candid just-woke-up UGC",
    "environment": {
      "left": "white dresser with blurry clutter on top",
      "behind": "unmade bed with rumpled grey and black bedding",
      "walls": "neutral off-white"
    }
  },
  "subject": {
    "description": "young adult woman early 20s",
    "expression": "neutral, slightly tired / pensive, mouth closed",
    "gaze": "directly into camera",
    "skin": {
      "tone": "pale / fair",
      "detail": "prominent natural freckles on nose and cheeks",
      "finish": "matte-natural, visible pores, no plastic beauty filter"
    },
    "eyes": {
      "color": "dark brown",
      "look": "heavy-lidded / sleepy"
    },
    "lips": "full, natural no makeup",
    "hair": {
      "color": "dark brown",
      "style": "messy voluminous waves / soft curls",
      "detail": "many fine flyaway strands around face and forehead",
      "vibe": "damp or just-woke-up, not salon"
    },
    "clothing": {
      "top": "black ribbed tank top",
      "extra": "black cardigan or sweater sleeve visible on extended arm"
    },
    "pose": {
      "arm": "right arm extended toward camera (selfie)",
      "shoulder": "casual forward lean"
    }
  },
  "lighting": {
    "type": "soft diffused natural light",
    "direction": "from camera-left / window-left",
    "face": "gentle highlight left, soft shadow right",
    "quality": "overcast-soft, low contrast"
  },
  "camera": {
    "device": "modern smartphone front camera",
    "look": "raw UGC: mild noise, slight compression, shallow background blur",
    "focus": "sharp on face and hair strands"
  },
  "negative_prompt": [
    "beauty filter glaze",
    "plastic skin",
    "perfect salon hair",
    "studio lighting",
    "text",
    "UI",
    "logos",
    "watermarks",
    "extra people",
    "anime",
    "CGI",
    "heavy makeup",
    "big smile",
    "different freckle pattern",
    "blonde hair"
  ],
  "final_generation_instruction": "One highly photorealistic vertical phone selfie matching the reference. Same freckled girl, messy dark waves, black ribbed tank, cluttered bedroom, soft left window light, tired-neutral expression. Authentic TikTok pause-frame. No text or interface."
}
```
